company_research.additional_context: Acceldata is the market leader in Enterprise Data Observability, founded in 2018. They have developed the world's first Enterprise Data Observability Platform. Their platform is delivered as a SaaS product and is used by global customers like HPE, HSBC, Visa, Freddie Mac, Manulife, Workday, Oracle, PubMatic, PhonePe (Walmart), Hersheys, Dun & Bradstreet. It is a Series-C funded company with investors including Insight Partners, March Capital, Lightspeed, Sorenson Ventures, Industry Ventures, and Emergent Ventures. They provide an Agentic Data Management platform that simplifies and speeds the ability for enterprises to deliver trusted data for AI and other initiatives.
